messages:
ops-oncall: :rotating_light: Getting reports from EU customers that high-priority pages didn't ring through. Incidentbot shows pages sent but no acks. Anyone seeing gaps on the notify side?
incident-bot: Automated summary: 18 pages attempted to oncall; 0 ack events recorded in ack-sink during window 1719988800-1719989000. Delivery statuses: 12=200, 6=202, 0=500 in dispatch logs. (id: ib-9876)
alex: Copy. Can someone paste the dispatch logs for the failing ids? I want to check headers and auth results.
incident-bot: Sample lines from dispatch log (truncated):
```
2023-08-12T14:40:05Z dispatch id=ib-9876 to=+44XXXX status=200 delivered=true ack_event_forwarded=false auth=cache_miss
2023-08-12T14:40:12Z dispatch id=ib-9901 to=+44YYYY status=202 delivered=true ack_event_forwarded=false auth=ok
2023-08-12T14:40:30Z dispatch id=ib-9934 to=+44ZZZZ status=200 delivered=true ack_event_forwarded=false auth=cache_miss
```
alex: Hmm auth=cache_miss lines stand out. That suggests the incidentbot's ack-forwarding service may not be using the rotated signing key.
maya: We're seeing 200/202 at the paging gateway but ack camera shows no incoming ack webhooks from mobile relays. Could be webhook signing mismatch (rotation yesterday at 03:00 UTC?)
jordan: I'm going to flip to manual SMS relay to ensure ops get pages. Executing manual relay now.
jordan: `./tools/pager relay --provider twilio --to +44XXXX --body "URGENT: oncall needed" --meta "failover"`
ops-oncall: I just got the SMS. :phone: Customer oncall (EU) confirmed they received it too.
alex: Good. Can someone check the ack-forwarder service logs for 1719988800-1719989100? Look for 401/403 or signature verify errors.
incident-bot: Ack-forwarder excerpt:
```
2023-08-12T14:41:02Z ack-forwarder warn verify_signature failed id=ib-9876 err="signature mismatch" token_ver=2 expected_ver=3
2023-08-12T14:41:15Z ack-forwarder info dropped_event id=ib-9934 reason="unsupported-signing-version"
```
maya: That matches token_ver drift. We rotated the webhook signing key yesterday and the ack-forwarder wasn't picked up in config sync (deploy failed on canary).
sre-lead: Root cause hypothesis: signing key rotation + config sync failure = ack-forwarder rejecting legitimate ack webhooks. Paging gateway shows delivery but ack sink never accepted the acks, so incidentbot thinks nobody acked.
ops-manager: Immediate mitigation: keep manual SMS relay for active alerts until we confirm ack-forwarder accepts events. Also open emergency deploy for ack-forwarder with correct key.
jordan: Emergency deploy started (canary -> 2 nodes). Monitoring health-checks.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout started for ack-forwarder (rev=deploy-2023-08-12-ackfix). Health: 1/1 ok on canary.
ops-oncall: After canary, I triggered a test page (low priority). SMS received AND ack event recorded in console. ack_event_count incremented.
alex: Confirmed in logs: verify_signature succeeded for test id=ib-test-111 now using token_ver=3. No more dropped_event entries.
maya: Rolling full deploy now.
sre-lead: Nice work. Next actions: (1) postmortem draft, (2) add alert for "ack_event_forwarded_rate" drop > 90% for 2m, (3) add deploy gating so signing rotations require ack-forwarder config rollout before scheduling rotation.
ops-manager: Filed follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1456 (runbook & monitoring). Also PR open to runbook: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/452
incident-bot: Incident resolved: paging delivery verified via SMS and ack-forwarder restored. Summary appended to incident log id=inc-2023-08-12-ib-9876.
ops-oncall: Thanks all. Small note: need an SOP for manual-sms failover and a lightweight `pager failover` command for oncall. I'll author.
alex: I'll include the signing-rotation checklist in the change template so this doesn't slip again.
maya: I'll own the postmortem and schedule a retro with SRE + Pager infra next Wed.
sre-lead: Closing here. If any customer follow-ups needed, ops-manager will handle comms.
summary: Incident: ack-forwarder rejected webhook acks after signing key rotation; pages delivered but no ack events recorded; manual SMS failover used until ack-forwarder redeployed with correct key. Follow-ups: alerting, runbook, deploy gating.
